purpose: Explicitly preserve unknown/undetermined areas so runtime or future development does not silently invent definitive Canon. This file may also hold source-confirmed truths whose information-access classification has not yet been audited; those facts must not enter ordinary public packets until classified.

items.subject: emily
items.note: Restricted records support at least a mature-Master + 8-circle composite assessment, but Emily's true upper limit, origin, and full past remain unconfirmed.

items.subject: world_geography
items.note: Known imperial regions, Dominus, frontier and sea zones do not constitute a complete map/list of every state on the continent.

items.subject: dominus
items.note: Basic theocratic hierarchy and relation with Lumensia are known; detailed internal factions and politics are not fully established.

items.subject: spirit_realm
items.note: Fire/water/wind/earth Spirit Kings and their broad cosmological role exist, but individual names and precise current conditions are not fully established in the migrated Canon.

items.subject: lily_lumina
items.note: Religious belief, imperial secret writings, magic-tower models, and direct truth must remain distinct. Lily's actual current intent is not confirmed.

items.subject: authority_system
items.note: There is no confirmed official numeric grade system for Authorities. Comparative power depends on the law involved, user realm, soul strength, mastery, conditions, and costs. Do not invent an S/SSS-style Authority grade ladder.

items.subject: laris
items.confirmed_truth: 라리스는 본가 검술 외의 다른 유파를 몰래 연구하고 있다.
items.note: Legacy NPC Canon explicitly labels this a secret, but the exact set of people who know it and the appropriate visibility level have not been source-audited. Keep it out of ordinary public character packets until classified.

items.subject: serena
items.confirmed_truth: 세레나는 과거 루시아와의 대련에서 큰 부상을 낸 사건 이후 공격마법 사용에 심리적 부담과 두려움이 있다.
items.note: The underlying event/trauma is source-confirmed, but dissemination beyond the directly involved people has not been audited.

items.subject: chloe
items.confirmed_truth: 클로에는 귀족들의 약점을 사고파는 고위험 정보거래에도 관여한다.
items.note: Legacy NPC Canon explicitly labels this a secret. Public rumor about Chloe trading information is already separate Knowledge Canon; the exact access level for the high-risk activity remains unaudited.

items.subject: elise
items.confirmed_truth: 엘리제는 레이하트 직계 일부에게 발현하는 혈통 Trait '매혹의 시선(Gaze of Charm)'을 보유한다. 강제 정신지배가 아니라 약한 호감과 경계 완화 방향에 작용한다.
items.note: The trait itself is explicitly confirmed in later legacy Canon, but who knows the exact mechanism has not been source-audited. Do not expose it through ordinary public packets until classified.

items.subject: sera
items.confirmed_truth: 세라가 과거 용병단에서 비공식 임무를 수행했다는 이야기는 source에서 소문으로만 제시된다.
items.note: Truth is not confirmed. The exact social reach of the rumor has not been audited, so do not invent who has heard it.
